recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is recommended for FHIR-48390 unless the work group later decides to alter DiagnosticReport.communication's scope or target type.
issue_request: FHIR-48390 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request for R6 asking to add DiagnosticReport.communication as 0..* Reference(Communication), with definition, short display, requirements, summary=false, and comments limiting the element to communications initiated during generation of the DiagnosticReport while excluding post-publication communications.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation through HL7/fhir PR #3217. The Jira comment links to PR commit 4d99d3c, and the source-changing commit in that PR, 8e3b4931d5a3f7b4804f6a874544896443776359, added DiagnosticReport.communication to source/diagnosticreport/structuredefinition-DiagnosticReport.xml.
additional_context: DiagnosticReport is active in source/fhir.ini and owned by OO, so the inspected StructureDefinition is in current build scope. OO Confluence minutes record that the group wanted a core element for communications during report development, ruled out an extension, and voted persuasive. Later FHIR-53501 only added an R6 ballot note listing DiagnosticReport.communication among new DiagnosticReport elements and did not alter the element semantics. Jira and Zulip searches found no conflicting later evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current DiagnosticReport StructureDefinition already defines DiagnosticReport.communication with 0..* cardinality, Reference(Communication), summary=false, and the requested definition, comment, and requirements.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied DiagnosticReport ballot-note issue lists DiagnosticReport.communication as a new R6 element without changing the element semantics.
